title: 10th Day
categoryChain: Everyday short duas in the month of Ramadhan

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِيْ فِيْهِ مِنَ الْمُتَوَكِّلِيْنَ عَلَيْكَ،
verses.translation: O Allah, on this day, (please) include me with those who rely upon You,
include me on this day with those who win with You,
and include me on this day with those drawn near to You,
in the name of Your beneficence, O ultimate goal of the seekers!
